about: Every game on the shelf claims one type (game.json "type"). Each new game should take a type no game has used yet; see `npm run types`. If your idea is a genuinely different kind of game, add a new type here rather than squeezing it into a near match. Keep ids kebab-case and the descriptions about how the game is PLAYED, not its theme.

types.name: Word game
types.about: Make, find, guess or arrange words.
types.examples: Press Run, crossword minis, Boggle, word ladders, codebreakers

types.name: Typing game
types.about: Speed and accuracy at the keyboard drive the action.
types.examples: typing shooter, typing racer, type-to-cast spells

types.name: Arcade shooter
types.about: Real-time aiming, shooting and dodging.
types.examples: Asteroids, shmups, bullet heaven (Vampire Survivors)

types.name: Paddle and pinball
types.about: Keep a ball in play with flippers, paddles or bumpers.
types.examples: a pinball table, Breakout with a twist, Pong variants

types.name: Platformer
types.about: Run and jump through levels with precise movement.
types.examples: one-screen precision platformer, auto-runner, metroidvania-lite

types.name: Racing and driving
types.about: Steer for the best line and time.
types.examples: top-down drift racer with ghosts, time trials, delivery driving

types.name: Aim and trajectory
types.about: Set angle and power, then watch physics play out.
types.examples: orbit golf, mini golf, artillery, slingshot

types.name: Drop, stack and merge
types.about: Drop physics objects that stack, balance or merge.
types.examples: Suika merge-drop, tower stacking, balance games

types.name: Sandbox toy
types.about: An emergent system to play with more than win.
types.examples: falling sand, marble run builder, Rube Goldberg machines

types.name: Logic puzzle
types.about: Deduce a unique solution on a grid; ideal as a daily puzzle.
types.examples: Nonogram, Star Battle, Queens, Sudoku variants, Minesweeper-likes

types.name: Spatial puzzle
types.about: Handcrafted levels about moving or rotating things in space.
types.examples: Sokoban, sliding blocks, mirrors and lasers, pipe rotation

types.name: Programming puzzle
types.about: Build a program or machine that solves the level.
types.examples: Human Resource Machine-like, Opus Magnum-lite, conveyor factories

types.name: Match and merge puzzle
types.about: Swap, slide or match tiles to clear or combine them.
types.examples: match-3 with a twist, 2048 or Threes-likes, mahjong solitaire

types.name: Card solitaire
types.about: Patience-style games with a standard or custom deck.
types.examples: an original patience game, Golf, pyramid variants

types.name: Deckbuilder
types.about: Fight or score with a deck you build during the run.
types.examples: Slay the Spire-lite, card battler

types.name: Dice and slot builder
types.about: Build an engine around luck: dice, reels or draws.
types.examples: Luck Be a Landlord, dice placement (Dicey Dungeons), push-your-luck

types.name: Roguelike crawler
types.about: Turn-based grid exploration and combat with permadeath.
types.examples: Brogue-lite, Hoplite, one-screen dungeons

types.name: Tactics
types.about: Turn-based squad battles with perfect information.
types.examples: Into the Breach-like, chess-puzzle skirmishes

types.name: Tower defense
types.about: Place defences to stop waves along a path.
types.examples: mazing tower defense, lane defense

types.name: Abstract strategy vs AI
types.about: A solo board game against a computer opponent.
types.examples: a chess variant, mancala, an original abstract game

types.name: Tile placement builder
types.about: Place pieces to build a landscape and score combos.
types.examples: Islanders, Dorfromantik, solo Carcassonne

types.name: Management sim
types.about: Run a business or place: economy, staff, customers.
types.examples: bakery, theme park, shopkeeper, restaurant

types.name: Incremental / idle
types.about: Numbers grow, automation unlocks, progress continues offline.
types.examples: Cookie Clicker, Universal Paperclips

types.name: Colony and ecosystem sim
types.about: Guide many autonomous agents indirectly.
types.examples: ant colony, aquarium ecosystem, Lemmings-style guidance

types.name: Network drawing
types.about: Draw routes or connections as demand grows.
types.examples: Mini Metro, flow routing, power grids

types.name: Rhythm game
types.about: Act on the beat of the music.
types.examples: note lanes on generated music, one-button beat game

types.name: Music toy
types.about: Play is making music.
types.examples: generative instrument, step-sequencer garden, draw-to-play

types.name: Deduction mystery
types.about: Work out what happened from evidence and clues.
types.examples: Golden Idol-lite, Clue-like casebooks

types.name: Inspection under pressure
types.about: Check things against changing rules against the clock.
types.examples: Papers, Please-like, quality control, spot the difference

types.name: Interactive fiction
types.about: A story driven by choices, stats or text commands.
types.examples: branching story, text adventure, choose-your-path with stats

types.name: Memory and knowledge
types.about: Remember, recall or estimate.
types.examples: memory grids, geography quiz, guess-the-year from public data

types.name: Drawing game
types.about: Drawing or gestures are the main input.
types.examples: draw platforms that become physics objects, Line Rider, trace runes

types.name: Maze, chase and stealth
types.about: Navigate mazes, evade or sneak past pursuers.
types.examples: Pac-Man-likes, stealth rooms, generated labyrinths

types.name: 3D exploration
types.about: Move through a 3D world (three.js).
types.examples: low-poly glider, marble roller, walking sim

types.name: Cozy care loop
types.about: Low-pressure tending that grows over days.
types.examples: a garden that grows between visits, fishing, pet care

types.name: Sports arcade
types.about: A sport distilled to one satisfying skill.
types.examples: penalty shootout, bowling, curling, darts
